title: Introduce sample-based onboarding sanity sampler and contextual changelog suggester
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a lightweight, sample-based sanity sampler to the model onboarding flow plus a contextual changelog suggester that drafts human-readable release notes from sample diffs. Motivation: onboarding full telemetry or running exhaustive evals is expensive; teams need a quick, reproducible sanity check that exercises the most representative request patterns for a model variant and surfaces concrete examples for changelogs. The sampler uses a stratified sampling strategy over model profile shards (token length distribution, request surface, dataset tags) and an output-fingerprint clustering pass to pick 20-50 representative inputs to run against both the candidate and baseline models. The changelog suggester executes the sample set, computes signal deltas (exact-match, BLEU-ish, hallucination heuristics, safety flags), and synthesizes a short changelog draft with prioritized bullets and one concrete example per bullet. Checklist: - [x] sampler algorithm and unit tests - [x] onboarding CLI flag --sanity-sample and CI runner integration - [x] changelog suggester library and draft serializer - [x] small UX additions to the registry UI for previewing suggested bullets (read-only) - [x] docs and runbook for interpreting sampler output How to run locally: ./cli/onboard.py --model-path ./weights --profile ./profiles/foo.json --sanity-sample --sample-output out/sanity.json Then ./tools/changelog_suggester.py --samples out/sanity.json --baseline-id model:v1 --out out/changelog_draft.md Collision handling and guardrails: samples are capped at 50 runs; sensitive or PII-detected requests are redacted at collection time; all suggested bullets are flagged with a confidence score and an example id so that product owners can quickly triage. Notes on safety: the suggester deliberately avoids automated pushes to release notes; it only outputs drafts for human review.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice approach. Can you explain how the stratified shards are chosen and whether that biases toward long-tail requests?

Maya Patel: The shards are derived from the profile histogram (length, source tag, model-route). We cap representation from rare shards to avoid over-emphasizing long-tail; added tests to validate sampling weights.
Aisha Rahman: We should be explicit about redaction and PII handling before running on customer profiles. Add a runbook entry.
Maya Patel: Added redaction module and docs entry; sampler will no-op on profiles with pii_consent=false per policy.
Noah Garcia: CI flaky on profiler integration; one e2e failed in first run due to timeout. Can you make the smoke job tolerant?
Maya Patel: Increased timeout and added retry in the CI job; subsequent runs pass.
summary_of_changes: Adds an onboarding sampler that produces a compact, representative sample set and a suggester that drafts contextual changelogs by running those samples against baseline and candidate models. Includes CLI flags, small UI preview, tests, and CI integration.
release_notes: Added: onboarding --sanity-sample flag to produce representative sample sets for quick sanity checks. Added: changelog suggester tool that drafts release notes with prioritized bullets and concrete examples. Note: outputs are drafts and require human review; no automatic publishing.
motivation_and_context: Customers and internal teams requested a faster onboarding safety net to catch regressions without full-scale telemetry runs. This PR targets that gap by providing reproducible, small-sample checks and an automated draft generator to speed release note authoring. The implementation prioritizes reproducibility, low cost, and human-in-the-loop review.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for shard weighting and fingerprint clustering. Integration tests exercise end-to-end sample generation and suggester scoring against a small baseline fixture. CI has a smoke job that runs a 10-sample end-to-end flow to catch regressions in infra changes.
rollback_instructions: Revert the feature branch or disable --sanity-sample flag in onboarding; remove registry UI preview via feature flag registry.ui.changelog_preview=false. No data migrations performed.
notes_for_releasers: This is non-breaking. When deploying, enable the registry UI preview behind the feature flag and validate that the CI smoke sampler job runs within the allocated time window. Product should review suggested drafts before publishing release notes.
